title: SOP for TriZOL RNA and Protein Extraction
author: Malu G Tansey
materials: Bucket of ice and dry ice

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare the work surface and organize materials for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Clean work surface and hands with RNAse Zap.
Prepare the following tubes per sample: two 1.5 mL clear tubes, one RNeasy tube (pink), and one QIAshredder tube (purple).
Label all tubes specifically and arrange them in the order: clear, purple, pink, clear.
Keep all samples on dry ice until TRIzol is added.

steps.title: Lyse Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue sample using TRIzol and a tissue lyser.

substeps.instruction: In a hood, add 500uL or 1000uL (depending on tissue size) of ice cold TRIzol to a 2mL tube containing the sample and 1 tissue lyser bead.
Place tubes in tissue lyser adaptors with the 'big side' facing out.
Operate the tissue lyser for 2min at 20Hz; rearrange racks and repeat the cycle 2-3x.
Perform a quick spin (few seconds) in a 4 deg C centrifuge or table top mini centrifuge to remove foam.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate into aqueous and organic phases.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a new 1.5mL tube.
Add 1/5 volume of chloroform and shake for 15 sec (invert a few times by hand).
Incubate at room temperature (RT) for 2-3min.
Centrifuge for 15min at 12,000xrpm at 4 deg C until layers separate into clear RNA (top), white DNA (middle), and pink protein (bottom).
Perform a fast temperature centrifuge to RT.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to either a Qiashredder tube for RNA isolation or a 1.5mL tube for storage.
Record the volume of the RNA phase transferred to ensure an equal volume of 70% EtOH is added later.

steps.title: Isolate RNA
steps.instruction: Purify RNA using QIAshredder and RNeasy spin columns.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the Qiashredder tube for 2min at full speed at RT (21-23°C); retain the flow-through and discard the column (alternatively, store flow-through at -80 deg C).
Add 1 volume of 70% EtOH to the flow-through and pipette to mix.

Transfer up to 700uL of the sample (including any precipitate) to an RNeasy spin column in a collection tube; centrifuge for 15sec at 10,000 RPM and discard flow-through. Repeat if volume exceeds 700uL.
Add 700uL Buffer RW1 to the column; centrifuge for 15sec at 10,000 RPM and discard flow-through.
Add 500uL Buffer RPE (with EtOH added) to the column; centrifuge for 15sec at 10,000 RPM and discard flow-through.
Add another 500uL Buffer RPE (with EtOH added) to the column; centrifuge for 2min at 10,000 RPM and discard flow-through.
Place the column in a new collection tube and centrifuge for 1min at full speed; discard flow-through.

steps.title: Elute and Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the purified RNA and measure its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Place the RNeasy spin column in a new, labeled 1.5mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 30-100uL RNAse-free water directly to the white part of the column membrane (for gut samples, start with 50uL; increase to 100uL if protein concentration is over 2000).
Centrifuge for 1min at 10,000 RPM to elute RNA and place tubes on ice.
Measure RNA concentration using a Nanodrop 2000: select nucleic acid, decline saving workbook, verify wavelength, set type to RNA, blank with 1uL RNA water, and measure samples.
Target concentration is ~1000ng/uL (minimum 100ng/uL) with 260/280 and 260/230 ratios between 1.9-2.2.

steps.title: Collect Protein
steps.instruction: Recover and resuspend protein from the organic phase.

substeps.instruction: If DNA/protein was stored on ice, ensure tubes are upright. Remove the white DNA layer completely to facilitate protein resuspension.
Add 1-1.2mL cold MeOH to the phenol/chloroform layer and invert to mix.
Incubate at RT for 10min.
Centrifuge for 10min at 12,000xrpm at 4 deg C and remove the supernatant.
Wash the pellet with 500uL cold MeOH, mixing by pipetting up and down with a p1000 tip.
Centrifuge for 10min at 12,000xrpm at 4 deg C and remove the supernatant, allowing most MeOH to evaporate.
Resuspend the pellet in 50-150uL 1% SDS using a pestle motor mixer (mixer can be rinsed with 70% EtOH, water, and a Kim wipe between samples).
Heat the sample to 50 deg C using a p1000 to complete resuspension.
Measure protein concentration via BCA assay.
